verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is a unified LLM API gateway. The evidence shows no product feature for setting up background automations, such as scheduled jobs, triggers, or autonomous recurring runs. Automatic model/provider fallbacks and the guide on building agents with tool use and loops are request-level routing behaviour and developer building blocks, not a first-party automation capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
